generalAbilities.name: Glimpse Fate
generalAbilities.description: A finitrium fatebender gains a +5 circumstance bonus when rolling Perception for initiative, as it acts on flashes of insight harvested from potential futures.

defensiveAbilities.name: A Million Fates
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. A finitrium fatebender is surrounded by an aura of countless shifting potential futures—fragmented milliseconds of possibility all overlapping in a tumultuous blur. A creature that ends its turn in the aura must attempt a DC 33 Will Saving Throw save. If it fails, it's Sickened 2 for 1 round (or 1d4 rounds on a critical failure). A creature that critically succeeds becomes temporarily immune to the aura for 1 day.

defensiveAbilities.name: Fated Outcome
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger The finitrium fatebender fails or critically fails an attack roll or saving throw

Effect The finitrium fatebender rerolls the triggering check and takes the better result.

defensiveAbilities.name: Tactical Prescience
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Trigger The finitrium fatebender would be hit by a Strike

Effect Having foreseen the incoming attack, the finitrium fatebender shifts position, gaining a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fate Wave
offensiveAbilities.description: The finitrium fatebender releases a wave of twisted futures and shattered possibilities, dealing 16d6 Mental Damage damage in a 60ft Type:cone (Basic DC 36 Will Saving Throw save). The finitrium fatebender can't use Fate Wave again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Foretell Doom
offensiveAbilities.description: Any creature hit by the finitrium fatebender's fist or ray of twisted fate Strikes receives a vision of their impending death at the hands of the finitrium fatebender. It must succeed at a DC 36 Will Saving Throw save or become Stupefied 2; on a critical failure, the creature is also Stunned 1. If the creature is already affected by foretold doom, it increases the appropriate stunned and stupefied values by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of Stunned 2 and Stupefied 4. When the finitrium fatebender is destroyed, the creature has avoided this tragic fate and immediately recovers from its stupefied condition.

offensiveAbilities.name: Inexorable March
offensiveAbilities.description: The finitrium fatebender Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging creatures that try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt a DC 40 Fortitude Saving Throw save to bar the way, stopping the finitrium fatebender's movement on a success. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise, it's damaged as if hit by the finitrium fatebender's fist Strike.
